QuestInfo.name: [Hilla] Find the Passage
QuestInfo.0: #bPrime Minister Longorias#k will give you the details.
QuestInfo.1: Find the #bpassage#k that the outsiders use and chase #bthem#k away. Use the #bportal on the right#k of the Azwan Refugee Zone to get to the lower floor of Azwan.
QuestInfo.2: You've located the passage and defeated the Grave Robbers. You can use the #bportal on the right#k of the Azwan Refugee Zone to go to the Azwan Lower Floor.

0.0: Good to see you here. I'll get right to the point. There are several underground passageways in Azwan that let you get to the surface without passing through here. Some of the trespassers have found them, and are using them to invade. Can you clear the villains out?

yes.0: Use the portal on the right and start your search from there.

no.0: I'm sorry. I guess I asked too much of you.

1.0: Seems you located all the passageways and defeated all the Grave Robbers.
